footnote_text: These securities were purchased by the reporting person in the registered direct offering of CytoSorbents Corporation (the "Issuer"), which closed on November 20, 2026. In the offering, each share of common stock, par value $0.001 per share (the "Common Stock") of the Issuer was purchased at an offering price of $5.18 per share of Common Stock. || Includes (a) the following restricted stock units ("RSUs") which will vest upon a "Change of Control" of the Issuer, as defined in the CytoSorbents Corporation 2014 Long-Term Incentive Plan (the "Plan"): (i) 165 RSUs granted on March 15, 2018, (ii) 300 RSUs granted on February 24, 2017, (iii) 3,000 RSUs granted on June 7, 2016, and (b) 4,099 shares of Common Stock owned by the Reporting Person. || Reflects the 1-for-20 reverse stock split effected by the Issuer on September 8, 2026.
